messages:
nina: Quick design review — stepper control for min/max capacity and the burst budget tooltip. a few accessibility + copy items.
omar: droppin in. what's the main problem?
li: saw this in usability test: people thought the + / - stepper changed % of pool, not absolute GPU count. we need clearer labeling.
taylor: yep — current label says 'min instances' but context is ambiguous. propose 'Min GPUs (instances)' and 'Max GPUs (instances)'. add a short helper text under the control: 'changes reserve capacity for this pool'.
nina: agree. also keyboard behavior: shift+arrow should step by 10, alt+arrow by 1 gpu-hour for burst budget? we need consistent modifiers.
omar: I'd keep modifiers consistent across controls. shift for larger jumps (10), ctrl/meta for 5. alt is risky on some OSes.
li: +1 on shift=10, ctrl=5. also announce changes to the cost preview via aria-live="polite" so screen-reader users hear the updated monthly estimate.
taylor: good call. current cost preview is visually updated but not announced. add aria-atomic as well.
ops-bot: autoscale-guardrails: reminder — SLO slider currently clamps at 2000ms max; some users asked for a 5s option.
nina: let's not encourage super-high latencies. but add a soft guardrail with tooltip: 'Values above 2s may degrade UX; consider increasing pool size instead.' and make the slider allow up to 5000ms with a warning state.
omar: warning state could be amber with an inline helper link to docs on tradeoffs. make sure contrast is ok.
li: microcopy: burst budget label currently 'Burst Quota' — suggest 'Burst budget (GPU-hours)' to avoid ambiguity.
taylor: +1. also badge on pool chips that shows remaining burst should use a compact format like '2.4h' not '2.4 hours' for space constraints, but the tooltip should expand the unit.
nina: for keyboard users, ensure chip badges are ignored by tab order and announced via the chip button's aria-describedby so screen readers still convey remaining budget.
omar: visual: focus ring on stepper overlaps the up/down chevrons in compact view. solution: increase padding or move ring outward. prefer using outline-offset token.
li: test ask: add a Cypress e2e that tabs through pool picker, verifies the min/max stepper keyboard increments (shift and ctrl combos), and asserts aria-live announces cost. small smoke.
taylor: I'll write the e2e. also will change the burst modal CTA from 'Force Burst' to 'Allow temporary burst' and add copy 'This will temporarily increase capacity for up to X hours.'
nina: can we add a short cooldown mention: 'Cooldown: 1h' in the modal so users know when they can re-use it?
omar: yes, show the cooldown as secondary text and disable CTA if still cooling down. also for accidental clicks add a 3s countdown on CTA.
li: accessibility checklist: focus trap in modal, aria-modal="true", initial focus on the explanation heading, not CTA, escape should close, and announce modal open via aria-live.
taylor: updated figma link: https://figma.com/file/efgh5678/autoscale-stepper-burst-copy — comments left.
nina: thanks — i'll do a copy PR and small a11y tweaks PR. once merged we'll run the aria-scan job.
ops-bot: Reminder: schedule accessibility scan in 24h.
